mods.name: Minecraft Linux Terminal
mods.description: A Fabric mod providing a host terminal (Linux PTY & Windows ConPTY) and incremental YAML/NBT container filesystem mount in Minecraft.

releases.notes:
## Minecraft Linux Terminal v1.0.0 (Linux & Windows)

- **Minecraft**: 26.3 (Fabric Loader >= 0.20.1, Fabric API, Java 25+)
- **Dual-Platform Universal Jar**:
  - **Linux / macOS**: Native interactive PTY via Python `pty.openpty()`
  - **Windows**: Native interactive **Win32 ConPTY** (`CreatePseudoConsole` via bundled JNA) with piped fallback
- **Config (`config/linux_terminal.json`)**: Configure default `shell` (`auto`, `zsh`, `bash`, `fish`, `pwsh`, `powershell`, `cmd`, `git-bash`, `wsl`, or full path) and `mountDir` (defaults to `~/minecraft_mount`).
- **Incremental Container Mount**: Automatically mounts online player inventories (`<mountDir>/<playerName>/`) and nearby world containers (`<mountDir>/<dimension>/<block>_<x>_<y>_<z>/`), with full structured `.yaml` + Data Components/NBT serialization, nested container-item directories (`shulker_box`, `bundle`, chests with items), virtual folders, and symlinks.
